routes.trigger: Codex planning review of an issue or spec with decisions affecting acceptance
routes.gate: record confirmed decisions before task.py start

routes.trigger: Codex implementation of reviewed issue, spec, or active Trellis planning artifacts
routes.gate: load project specs through trellis-before-dev and complete relevant verification before trellis-check

routes.trigger: reported defect, incorrect result, or performance regression in an active task
routes.gate: reproduce the reported symptom and verify the repair before trellis-check

routes.trigger: user requests test-first development or integration tests
routes.gate: record the public test boundary and red-green evidence before trellis-check

routes.trigger: recorded high-risk change to shared control, hardware safety, ROS public interface, or migration
routes.gate: complete trellis-check and address blocking findings before spec update or commit
